Source: .briefs/eval-gap-v2-human-lens.md section 4, authored by Fable (Eval V2 Audit, surface:55). Operator-approved 2026-08-12. Read that section for the full human-problem framing before starting. (V2-9, ~20 min.) OPERATOR BUG REPORT, 2026-08-12.

PROBLEM. In the latent.space register theme, side scrollbars, the 'Filter Sessions' box, and other text inputs render without the theme's color treatment — native controls fall back to light defaults on the black gradient. Root cause: src/styles/themes/latent-space.css contains NO input, scrollbar, or color-scheme rules.

GOOD LOOKS LIKE. color-scheme: dark on the register's root, plus tokenized input / select / textarea treatment, scoped under html[data-theme='latent-space']. While you are there, audit ai-engineer.css for the same class of gap.

BINDING RULES. DESIGN.md section Themes: every color is a token, 4.5:1 contrast floor. No raw hex.

CLOSES NO EVAL ITEM. Small, isolated, and safe to run at any time — no sequencing constraint, which makes it a good filler for an agent that is blocked on someone else's merge.

VERIFY. Load the latent.space theme; scrollbars, the Filter Sessions box, and every text input carry the theme treatment; contrast holds at 4.5:1.
data.title: V2-9: latent.space theme leaves native controls unstyled

data.body: Implementation and validation complete. PR #141 is open at https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/141. Commits 1503ef7f and dbd2ee8a. Static local browser proof confirmed dark native controls, successful typing, and 16.90:1 text / 5.52:1 placeholder contrast. AI Engineer audit required no change. No eval item closed.
